entities.name: Carl Rabl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carl Rabl was an Austrian anatomist. His most notable achievement was on the structural consistency of chromosomes during the cell cycle. In 1885 he published that chromosomes do not lose their identity, even when they were not distinctly visible under the microscope.
